steps.en: Officer opens the page for uploading many notices
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman untuk upload banyak notice

steps.en: The template download is built, but a reported fault blocks it
steps.id: Download template sudah dibuat, tetapi ada laporan gangguan yang menghambatnya
steps.why_en: An open fault report says the template download fails with 'not found', so officers cannot get the template.
steps.why_id: Laporan gangguan yang masih terbuka menyebut download template gagal 'not found', sehingga officer tidak bisa mengambil template.

steps.en: The upload accepts Excel files, not the CSV files the story asks for
steps.id: Upload menerima file Excel, bukan file CSV seperti yang diminta story
steps.why_en: The system only accepts Excel (.xlsx) files; a CSV file is refused.
steps.why_id: Sistem hanya menerima file Excel (.xlsx); file CSV ditolak.

steps.en: The file is read and its columns are matched to the template
steps.id: File dibaca dan kolomnya dicocokkan dengan template

steps.en: Each row is checked; good and faulty rows are listed apart
steps.id: Tiap baris dicek; baris benar dan salah ditampilkan terpisah

steps.en: Officer confirms and every valid row becomes a notice
steps.id: Officer konfirmasi dan setiap baris valid menjadi notice

steps.en: Officer sees what was created, duplicated or failed
steps.id: Officer melihat mana yang berhasil dibuat, duplikat, atau gagal
